system.description: Some Marukan families are known for their hospitality. They take visitors in and treat them as blood, keeping them fed and happy and close. Some say they coddle enemies even more. The warrior-priests of Hiparkes try to epitomize that aspect of Marukan culture. This Charm enhances a clinch attack made from the saddle by eliminating any environmental penalties the character would normally suffer on the attempt, especially when galloping by. Additionally, the martial artist gains one automatic success on the attempt. Lightning Hooves use this Charm as much to extract friends from danger as they do to capture their enemies.
system.source: Scroll of the Monk: The Imperfect Lotus
